title: Marlowe & Finch Gift Registry Ledger Standard: Registry Credit Applied to an Order Line
content:
**Standard.** The registry credit of the Marlowe & Finch Gift Registry applied to an order line — the registrant's purchase record still in ordered status — is the line's selling price, never more than the registry credit available, that is the registry's credit entries for returned gifts less its registry credit used and converted entries; it is rounded half up to the cent once, on the final amount.

**Terms used**

| Term | Meaning |
|---|---|
| Selling price | the unit price on the registrant's purchase record of the order line |
| Registry credit available | the total of the registry's registry credit entries for returned gifts, less the total of its registry credit use entries, less the total of its registry credit conversion entries; taken as zero should these entries net to less than zero |
| Credit applied | the lesser of the selling price and the registry credit available, rounded once, half up to the cent |

**Worked figures (hypothetical registry)**

| Credit entries for returned gifts | Credit used | Converted | Available | Selling price | Credit applied |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| USD 210.00 | USD 134.70 | USD 0.00 | USD 75.30 | USD 140.00 | USD 75.30 |
| USD 210.00 | USD 0.00 | USD 0.00 | USD 210.00 | USD 49.95 | USD 49.95 |
| USD 90.00 | USD 90.00 | USD 0.00 | USD 0.00 | USD 49.95 | USD 0.00 |
